reader.requirement: At --std 85, when an index-name is the FROM operand of a PERFORM Format 4 VARYING or AFTER phrase, the compiler must refuse a varied identifier that is not an integer data item (a), a BY identifier that is not an integer data item (b), and a BY literal that is not an integer (c), at every VARYING and AFTER level.

construct perform-varying-by-omitted-2002: an omitted BY phrase is refused below 2002; the SR8 screen only runs on a present BY

refuter.evidence: Attacked the 1985 definition of integer (glossary: 'A numeric data item ... that does not include any digit positions to the right of the decimal point'; a numeric literal likewise) against the screen. refute-1985-059/src/r8ok.cob (run r8ok-001, EXIT 0): VARYING NP (99PP) FROM IX BY 100 printed NP=0000 0100 0200 0300; BY BP (9PP) printed N4=0002 0102 0202; BY BS (S99), BY BC (S9(4) COMP), BY +2 each printed N=02 04 06: P-scaled and signed integers admitted. src/r8bad.cob (r8bad-001): COBOL2120 for BY 2.0 (SR5 c), varied NQ PIC PP9 at VARYING and AFTER (SR5 a), BY BQ PIC PP9 (SR5 b), AFTER BY +1.0 (SR5 c). src/r8comma.cob with DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA (r8comma-001): COBOL2120 for BY 1,5 and BY 2,0 (not integers). Every lettered item and its degenerate forms refused, legal forms run.
